headings.title: Commands Deprecated or Removed in BIG-IP LTM 16.1.0

text:
BIG-IP LTM v16.1.0
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 16.1.0
CONNECTOR::profile
- get connector profile name.
CONNECTOR::remap
- set client/server IP/Port from connector.
HTTP2::header
- queries or modifies HTTP/2 pseudo-headers
MR::available_for_routing
- gets/sets the available_for_routing mode
for the current connection.
SSL::allow_nonssl
- gets/sets state of Non-SSL connections.
TCP::keepalive
- gets/sets the number of seconds before BIG-IP sends a keep-alive
packet on a TCP connection with no traffic
UDP::max_buf_pkts
- gets/sets the maximum buffer packets value of a UDP connection.
Commands Updated in BIG-IP LTM 16.1.0
L7CHECK::protocol
- gets/sets L7 protocol value
MR::message
- gets/sets details in the message routing table
SSL::forward_proxy
- sets the SSL forward proxy bypass feature to bypass or
intercept
Events Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 16.1.0
CONNECTOR_OPEN
- Triggered when the connector is about to raise the service connect.
